name: interface-builder
title: Interface Builder
description: Xcode's storyboard for React apps made of BL UI: scenes on a canvas composed from the kit's own components and containers (NavigationStack, TabView, SplitView, lists), edited in place; segues, delegates, outlets, the first responder and context in React's terms; Framer-style motion with spring and easing editors and a timeline; Google Fonts typography with live preview; a live preview, and the app as code.
